Bengaluru, Date: 01/02/2024

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred By Section 5 of The Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 (Karnataka Act NO 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the
factors specified clauses(i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966
such as the population area of the village the demand under land revenue In the village
and having regard to the administrative convenience , the Government Of the
Karnataka proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of T.N.Betta village of
Pavagada taluk Tumkur District and to constitute a new villages called
Chinnammanahalli and Eramuddanahatti as specified in schedule along with maps
with old survey numbers and new survey numbers assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercises of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice Is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the notification in the Official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the State Government
from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date specified above will
be considered by the State Government. Objections or suggestions may be addressed
to the Deputy Commissioner,Tumkur District,Tumkur.
SCHEDULE-1
Lands bearing Survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table bellow shall be exclude from limits of said village
of Pavagada taluk in Tumkur District to form a new Revenue village called as
Chinnammanahalli of Pavagada taluk Tumkur district along with the survey
numbers included in column (4)there of.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred By Section 5 of The Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 (Karnataka Act NO 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the
factors specified clauses(i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966
such as the population area of the village the demand under land revenue In the village

and having regard to the administrative convenience , the Government Of the
Karnataka proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of Ryapte village of
Pavagada taluk Tumkur District and to constitute a new villages called Appajihalli
and Reddywarahalli as specified in schedule along with maps with old survey
numbers and new survey numbers assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercises of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice Is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the notification in the Official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the State Government
from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date specified above will
be considered by the State Government. Objections or suggestions may be addressed
to the Deputy Commissioner,Tumkur District,Tumkur.

included in column (4)there of.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand

under land revenue in the village and other head of the account and having
regard to the administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka propose
s to issue a Notification to alter the limits of Gudur & Koganur village of
Afzalpur taluk, Kalaburgi district to constitute a new village Station Ghanagapur
and Gudur sub village as specified in schedule along with maps with old survey
numbers and new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days
from the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Kalaburgi
District.

SCHEDULE – 1
Land bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
as specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of
Gudur & Koganur villages of Afzalpur taluk, Kalaburgi District to form a new
revenue village called as Station Ghanagapur of Afzalpur taluka, Kalaburgi
District along with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Rules 1966such as the population, area of the village the demand
under land revenue in the village and other head of the account and having
regard to the administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka proposes
to afler, the extent of residential area by adding an area occupied by unrecorded
habitation within the boundary of KALLUGUDI Village of Harapanahalli Taluk of
Vijayanagara District, to oncert the existing Kodadur Tanda unrecorded habitation in
to a BIKKIMATTI THANDA/extension /part of the existing revenue village. The area
occupied by the said hamlet of the village is specified in the selhedule below.

Notification is hereby issued that Land bearing survey numbers and extent
specified in Schedule shall be declared as habitation area within the boundary of
KALLUGUDI Village for conversion of BIKKIMATTI THANDA unrecorded
habitation in to BIKKIMATTI THANDA /extension part of the said revenue village.
Now , therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said
Act, notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to
be affected thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or
after thirty days from the date of publication of the notification in the official
Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the
date Specified above will be considered by the state Government.
Objection or suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy
Commissioner, Vijayanagara District.

SCHEDULE
Land bearing survey numbers and extent specified below in column(3) of the
table shall be declared ashabitation area of called BIKKIMATTI THANDA village of
KALLUGUDI Taluk of Harapanahalli of Vijayanagara District convert the same to
form hamlet/extension within the boundary of of BIKKIMATTI THANDA Revenue
village and same will herein after be named as called BIKKIMATTI THANDA of
KALLUGUDI village in Harapanahalli Taluk of Vijayanagara District.

NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by clause (g) of sub-section (2) of section 69 of the
Bangalore Development Authority Act, 1976 (Karnataka Act 12 of 1976), the Government of
Karnataka hereby makes the following rules, further to amend the Bangalore Development Authority
(Allotment of sites) Rules, 1984, namely.-

RULES

1. Title and commencement.- (1) These rules may be called the Bangalore Development Authority
(Allotment of sites) (Amendment) Rules, 2024.

(2) They shall come in to force from the date of their publication in the official Gazette.

R.N.I. No. KARBIL/2001/47147 POSTAL REGN. No. RNP/KA/BGS/2202/2017-19
Licensed to post without prepayment WPP No. 297
2. Amendment of Rule 14.- In the Bangalore Development Authority (Allotment of sites) Rules, 1984,
in rule 14, in sub-rule (2), the following proviso shall be deemed to have been inserted with effect
from 30.04.2005, namely:-

"Provided that, where a lessee has alienated the site in contravention of the provisions of sub-
rule (2) prior to 31-12-2022, the Authority may, on application of the purchaser of such site
and subject to payment by the purchaser of an amount equal to twenty five percent of the
guidance value prevailing at the time of last sale transaction of that particular site, order for
regularization of such alienation and may convey the title to such purchaser."

By order and in the name of the
Governor of Karnataka,

(Rajesh S Sulikeri)
Under Secretary to Government, Urban
Development Dept.
